test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**ruminating**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the reasons behind the 'good vibes only' trend on social media.
 
• The appropriate verb should indicate the action of thinking deeply about something, especially something concerning.
 
• "**Ruminating**" fits well as it denotes thinking deeply about difficult realities, which aligns with the context of avoiding painful feelings.
 
• Other options ("**laminating**", "**collaborating**", "**stagnating**") do not fit the context of reflecting deeply.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *As community-minded creatures who want deeply to belong, we often mirror others, including on social media, where we adopt phrasing, tone and expressions of emotion. In the past few years, social media has had a focus on hyper positivity: think cheery emojis and motivational quotes plastered over sunsets. Some put this 'good vibes only' trend down to the pandemic and a desire to avoid painful feelings when reflecting on difficult realities. However, attempting to convey constant happiness is not only difficult but impossible.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Laminating" means covering something with a protective layer, which does not fit the context of thinking deeply.
 
• "Collaborating" means working together with others, which does not convey the idea of reflecting on something.
 
• "Stagnating" means ceasing to develop or advance, which does not align with the context of deep contemplation.
